events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering a hip-hop legend whose influence still resonates today. Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55, continues to define an era.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Guitar Legend Remembered
events.blurb: The music world remembers Jimi Hendrix, who tragically passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Genius
angles.copy: Still sounds as fresh and groundbreaking today as it did decades ago. Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

events.title: Abbey Road: The Beatles' Iconic Album
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring classics like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: That iconic cover, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day, forever changing music.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: The voice of The Pretenders, a true rock 'n' roll icon. Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Released
events.blurb: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: A timeless message of peace and hope. John Lennon's 'Imagine' first graced our airwaves on this day.

events.title: The Day the iPod Changed Music
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember carrying 1,000 songs in your pocket? The original iPod dropped on this day, changing everything.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic spy film franchise.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day – celebrating over six decades of the world's most famous secret agent.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: A voice that defined generations, a legacy that lives on. Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend. Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their double album, officially titled 'The Beatles', but commonly known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: A sprawling masterpiece that showed every side of the Fab Four. The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on this day.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Power
angles.copy: Still rocking us decades later. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80, on the anniversary of his passing.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', marking a significant shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day, changing pop music forever.

events.title: John Lennon: A Legacy Remembered
events.blurb: The music world marks the tragic anniversary of John Lennon's passing in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon's Passing
angles.copy: His music and message continue to inspire. Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86, on the anniversary of his tragic death.
